remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST DUE FRIDAY 9/12 AT 10AM!!!  Move right into this beautifully updated Colonial, lovingly cared for by the same family for more than 30 years. 19 Assisi Way has been more than an address, it's been a gathering place, a retreat, and the backdrop for countless memories. Now refreshed, it's ready for its next chapter. Located on one of the most desirable streets in the highly sought-after Wolfpit neighborhood, you'll immediately feel its balance of character and comfort. The first floor features an open plan with hardwood floors. The renovated kitchen isn't just for cooking, it's where mornings begin and holidays unfold, with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and room to gather. The dining room offers a fireplace and built-in coffee bar, while sunlight fills the living and family rooms. The family room easily flexes as a playroom, office, or exercise space. Upstairs, four bedrooms with hardwood floors and two full baths renovated with modern finishes create calm and functionality. A walk-up attic adds generous storage. Outside, the fenced, level yard includes an inground irrigation system, a patio, firepit, and lawn for barbecues, games, and evenings with friends - a true New England retreat. Updates like a new roof, bluestone walkway, and paved driveway add beauty and peace of mind. All this, just minutes from Metro-North, I95, and the Merritt, keeping you close to Norwalk's beaches, parks, and restaurants.
